summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and Tuple[ControlType, str] to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, which buffers the control only when is_terminal and otherwise returns False. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once per control. CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py, test_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run, per instructions; Black formatting not verified. Nothing committed.
